scope_limits: This accepts exactly 73 named declarations across three packages: 53 theorems, 19 definitions and one structure. The all-data QFA proposition is defined, not proved.

QFAHeatSmoothing constructs an actual positive-time physical H1-to-H2 heat map, nine weak Hessians, the literal Laplacian Fourier multiplier and the quantitative H2 bound. No time-integrated estimate, heat generator or nonlinear evolution is claimed.

QFALHRestart constructs full shifted physical Leray-Hopf membership of every supplied path at a nonnegative energy start, including actual weak momentum, all energy-class fields, and the original strict safe-window threshold. It does not construct an initial nonzero-data weak solution.

QFAZeroDatum proves the full strict and closed physical QFA conclusion for zero data: actual weak-solution nonemptiness, every supplied path, smooth zero velocity and point-normalized pressure, original-gradient tail energy equality and own-trace full LH future velocity uniqueness.
The exact all-data root retains arbitrary solenoidal L2 data and cutoff 8*norm(a)^4/(27*pi^4*nu^5); the nonzero-data obligations remain open.
Prior G05 and P08/M1 acceptance is preserved and freshly reaudited. G01, G02, G03, G04, G06, M2 and M3 remain open.
General physical QFA, WFA, canonical class root, sharp Sobolev admission and universal budget finiteness remain open.
The local reviewer only inspects Python text/JSON/hashes and immutable Git objects; no local Lean, Lake or kernel audit is executed.
